General Remarks.
The land sold during the year amounted to 52,454.81 acres, which realized $51,115.26. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department was, approximately, 453,930 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of Indian
Lands sold, amounted to $142,732.28, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.
